youtube_description: Lieutenant General Jasbir Lidder (ret'd) is Deputy Special Representative of the Secretary-General in Sudan. He previously served as Force Commander of the United Nation Mission to the Sudan. General Lidder has had a distinguished military career of over 40 years with the Indian Army, with extensive experience in counterinsurgency, counter-terrorism, peacekeeping and conventional war. He has held senior operational, command, staff and instructional appointments at home and abroad.
youtube_title: General Jasbir Lidder (retd) - Making peacekeeping work better: Guidance for integrated missions
